image_description: A dorsal view of a chiton (marine mollusk) clinging to a reddish-purple rocky substrate. The chiton has an oval shape with eight distinct, overlapping calcareous plates in the center, surrounded by a pinkish-purple leathery girdle with white speckles. The background rock is textured and covered with small orange encrusting organisms (likely tunicates or sponges). A cyan watermark text 'WWW.NATUREDIVER.COM ©' is visible at the bottom.
